name: Grants.gov API
known_limitations: Grant opportunities identify program intent and funding availability, not award outcomes, technical success, deployment, or local conversion evidence.
automation_notes: Search forecasted and posted opportunities by agency, funding category, keyword, and close date; pair with awards before making outcome claims.
notes: Phase 50 source recheck selected Grants.gov opportunity ID 361773, DE-FOA-0003589, Critical Minerals and Materials Accelerator Notice of Funding Opportunity. API search and fetchOpportunity metadata support funding-opportunity review only, not award, deployment, or technical-success claims.
